notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}.
It is an opponent's turn.
description:
During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, activate any number of lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Reset from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
